title: DeliveryProof Free Evaluation R3 — developer-executed synthetic regression

engine_video_regression.inputs: Four synthetic sample videos in original R3 ZIP, checked using R3 source engine and bundled MediaInfo native CLI
engine_video_regression.pass_criteria: Approved paths, SHA-256 and metadata PASS; delivery ZIP created and hashes matched
engine_video_regression.fail_criteria: Changed, missing or unapproved file identified and delivery ZIP blocked

evaluation_gate_regression.conditions: Fresh quota five; successful packages decrement to zero; sixth rejected; corrupt state fails closed
evaluation_gate_regression.data_scope: Disposable isolated evaluation state; no real user trial history modified

limitations: Developer-run synthetic cases, not independent customer validation or real footage
Run with local R3 Python source modules and genuine R3-bundled MediaInfo; not full frozen graphical EXE end-to-end validation
Publisher local ZIP hash has not been independently compared with the download served from Gumroad
Does not independently certify third-party library network behavior, Windows 11, managed endpoints or code signing
